subject: IN

context.title: My weekend
context.text: Last Saturday I (1) ______ up early because my cousins were coming to visit. They live (2) ______ Medellín, so they don't come very often. stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (1).

options.label: A
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa la forma -ing sin verbo auxiliar.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «I waking» no es una oración completa: le falta el auxiliar.

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. «Last Saturday» exige pasado simple, y el pasado de «wake» es «woke».

options.label: C
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa la tercera persona del presente con «I».
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Wakes» es para he/she/it y en presente; aquí el sujeto es «I» y la acción es pasada.

options.label: D
options.distractor_diagnosis: No conjuga en pasado pese a «Last Saturday».
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Wake» es presente; «Last Saturday» pide pasado.

context.title: Learning to swim
context.text: I (1) ______ afraid of water since I was a child. Last year, I finally decided to take swimming lessons. My teacher, Andrés, was very patient. At first, I couldn't put my face in the water, but he told me not (2) ______ worried. After a month, I was able (3) ______ across the pool. Now I go swimming twice a week. If I (4) ______ started earlier, I would have enjoyed many more holidays at the beach. I am really glad I didn't (5) ______ up.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (2).

options.label: A
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «To being» no es correcto aquí.

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. La estructura es «tell someone (not) to + verbo».

options.label: C
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. «Tell someone not to do something»: «not to be worried».

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. Después de «told me not» va el infinitivo con «to».

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (3).

options.label: A
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. Después de «able to» va el verbo base.

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Able swimming» no es correcto.

options.label: C
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Able» exige «to».

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. «Be able to» va seguido del verbo base: «able to swim».

subject: IN

context.title: Learning to swim
context.text: I (1) ______ afraid of water since I was a child. Last year, I finally decided to take swimming lessons. My teacher, Andrés, was very patient. At first, I couldn't put my face in the water, but he told me not (2) ______ worried. After a month, I was able (3) ______ across the pool. Now I go swimming twice a week. If I (4) ______ started earlier, I would have enjoyed many more holidays at the beach. I am really glad I didn't (5) ______ up.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (4).

options.label: A
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa presente en una condición sobre el pasado.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. La segunda parte («would have enjoyed») pide «had».

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. El tercer condicional usa «if + had + participio»: «If I had started».

options.label: C
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Has» va con he/she/it, y además el tiempo no corresponde.

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Would» va en la consecuencia, no después de «if».

subject: IN

context.title: Learning to swim
context.text: I (1) ______ afraid of water since I was a child. Last year, I finally decided to take swimming lessons. My teacher, Andrés, was very patient. At first, I couldn't put my face in the water, but he told me not (2) ______ worried. After a month, I was able (3) ______ across the pool. Now I go swimming twice a week. If I (4) ______ started earlier, I would have enjoyed many more holidays at the beach. I am really glad I didn't (5) ______ up.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (5).

options.label: A
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. El participio va con «have», no con «didn't».

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. Después de «didn't» va el verbo base: «didn't give up» (no me rendí).

options.label: C
options.distractor_diagnosis: Pone el verbo en pasado después de «didn't».
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Didn't» ya marca el pasado; el verbo va en forma base.

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. Después de «didn't» no se usa -ing.

subject: IN

context.title: Recycling at school
context.text: Our school started a recycling project two years ago. Since then, students (1) ______ more than three tonnes of plastic. Every classroom has three bins, and each one is used for a different material. The plastic (2) ______ to a local company that turns it into chairs and tables. The project was the idea of a group of students (3) ______ wanted to reduce waste in the cafeteria. At first, not many people were interested, but now almost everyone takes part. Our head teacher says that if we continue like this, we (4) ______ be able to buy new computers with the money we save. We are proud (5) ______ what we have achieved.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (1).

options.label: A
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. «Since then» indica algo que va desde el pasado hasta hoy: presente perfecto «have collected».

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Since» pide presente perfecto.

options.label: C
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Students collecting» no es una oración completa.

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Students» es plural: va «have».

subject: IN

context.title: Recycling at school
context.text: Our school started a recycling project two years ago. Since then, students (1) ______ more than three tonnes of plastic. Every classroom has three bins, and each one is used for a different material. The plastic (2) ______ to a local company that turns it into chairs and tables. The project was the idea of a group of students (3) ______ wanted to reduce waste in the cafeteria. At first, not many people were interested, but now almost everyone takes part. Our head teacher says that if we continue like this, we (4) ______ be able to buy new computers with the money we save. We are proud (5) ______ what we have achieved.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (2).

options.label: A
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa voz activa con un sujeto que no hace la acción.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. El plástico no envía nada; es enviado.

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. El plástico no se envía solo: hace falta la voz pasiva «is sent» (es enviado).

options.label: C
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa la forma base con un sujeto singular.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. Además de no ser pasiva, «send» no concuerda con «the plastic».

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «The plastic is sending» diría que el plástico envía algo.

subject: IN

context.title: Recycling at school
context.text: Our school started a recycling project two years ago. Since then, students (1) ______ more than three tonnes of plastic. Every classroom has three bins, and each one is used for a different material. The plastic (2) ______ to a local company that turns it into chairs and tables. The project was the idea of a group of students (3) ______ wanted to reduce waste in the cafeteria. At first, not many people were interested, but now almost everyone takes part. Our head teacher says that if we continue like this, we (4) ______ be able to buy new computers with the money we save. We are proud (5) ______ what we have achieved.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (3).

options.label: A
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Which» se usa con cosas.

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Whose» indica posesión (whose idea…), no es sujeto de «wanted».

options.label: C
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. Para personas («students») se usa «who» como sujeto de la oración relativa.

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Whom» es objeto; aquí hace falta el sujeto «who».

subject: IN

context.title: Recycling at school
context.text: Our school started a recycling project two years ago. Since then, students (1) ______ more than three tonnes of plastic. Every classroom has three bins, and each one is used for a different material. The plastic (2) ______ to a local company that turns it into chairs and tables. The project was the idea of a group of students (3) ______ wanted to reduce waste in the cafeteria. At first, not many people were interested, but now almost everyone takes part. Our head teacher says that if we continue like this, we (4) ______ be able to buy new computers with the money we save. We are proud (5) ______ what we have achieved.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (4).

options.label: A
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. En el primer condicional («if we continue») la consecuencia va con «will».

options.label: B
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa pasado para una consecuencia futura.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Did be able» no es correcto.

options.label: C
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa el segundo condicional con «continue» en presente.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. Con «if + presente», la consecuencia va con «will».

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «We are be able» no es correcto.

context.text: Our school started a recycling project two years ago. Since then, students (1) ______ more than three tonnes of plastic. The project was the idea of a group of students (3) ______ wanted to reduce waste in the cafeteria. At first, not many people were interested, but now almost everyone takes part. Our head teacher says that if we continue like this, we (4) ______ be able to buy new computers with the money we save. We are proud (5) ______ what we have achieved.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (5).

options.label: A
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. Se dice «proud of», no «proud for».

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. Con «proud» va «of».

options.label: C
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. La expresión es «proud of» (orgulloso de).

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. Con «proud» la preposición correcta es «of».

subject: IN

context.title: A strange day
context.text: Yesterday was a strange day. I (1) ______ to school when it started to rain very hard. I didn't have an umbrella, so I ran into a small shop. The woman (2) ______ worked there gave me a towel and a cup of hot chocolate. We talked for twenty minutes. (3) ______ I left, the sun was shining again. When I arrived at school, my teacher asked me (4) ______ I was late. I told her the story, and she smiled. I think I will go back to that shop (5) ______ say thank you.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (1).

options.label: A
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. Una acción en curso interrumpida por otra («when it started») va en pasado continuo: «I was walking».

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. El pasado continuo es «was + verbo -ing».

options.label: C
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa presente en un relato de ayer.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Yesterday» pide pasado.

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. Con «I» se usa «was».

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (2).

options.label: A
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. Para una persona («the woman») se usa «who».

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Where» se refiere a lugares.

options.label: C
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «What» no se usa después de un sustantivo como relativo.

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Whose» indica posesión, no es sujeto de «worked».

subject: IN

context.title: A strange day
context.text: Yesterday was a strange day. I (1) ______ to school when it started to rain very hard. I didn't have an umbrella, so I ran into a small shop. The woman (2) ______ worked there gave me a towel and a cup of hot chocolate. We talked for twenty minutes. (3) ______ I left, the sun was shining again. When I arrived at school, my teacher asked me (4) ______ I was late. I told her the story, and she smiled. I think I will go back to that shop (5) ______ say thank you.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (3).

options.label: A
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa un adverbio como conector de subordinación.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Then I left, the sun…» une mal las dos ideas.

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. «When I left» (cuando salí) marca el momento en que ya brillaba el sol.

options.label: C
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa una preposición delante de una oración.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «During» va con un sustantivo (during the class), no con «I left».

options.label: D
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa «since» con pasado continuo en la principal.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Since I left» pediría presente perfecto y cambia el sentido.

When I arrived at school, my teacher asked me (4) ______ I was late. I told her the story, and she smiled. I think I will go back to that shop (5) ______ say thank you.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (4).

options.label: A
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa «what» para preguntar por la causa.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «What I was late» no es correcto.

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. No se pregunta quién; se pregunta por qué.

options.label: C
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. En una pregunta indirecta sobre la causa se usa «why»: «asked me why I was late».

options.label: D
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Which I was late» no tiene sentido.

stem: Choose the correct word or words for gap (5).

options.label: A
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. Delante de un verbo, el propósito se expresa con «to».

options.label: B
options.explanation_feedback: Correcta. Para expresar propósito se usa «to + verbo»: «to say thank you».

options.label: C
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «At say» no es correcto.

options.label: D
options.distractor_diagnosis: Usa una preposición sin función aquí.
options.explanation_feedback: Incorrecta. «Of say» no es correcto.
